name: Bouncer
description: Deterministic contract enforcement for agent tool calls: gates the destination, not the tool. No LLM in the decision path.
author: Ezed9

tools.name: bouncer_check_verdict
tools.description: Evaluate a hypothetical tool call against Bouncer's deterministic security contracts and return the verdict (ALLOW, DENY, or ASK) with the underlying reason, without executing the tool.

tool.description: Name of the tool being called (e.g. 'send_email', 'write_file').

args.description: Arguments passed to the tool call.

untrusted_context.description: List of untrusted strings currently in context (from prior tool outputs).

user_policy_yaml.description: Optional YAML policy with custom contract overrides.

tools.name: bouncer_verify_policy
tools.description: Validate a YAML policy string against Bouncer's schema and report syntax validity, contract rules count, and covered tools.

tools.name: bouncer_get_active_policies
tools.description: Inspect all active contract packs (builtin rules for filesystem, email, http, bash, etc.) and user overrides loaded by Bouncer.

pack_name.description: Optional name of a specific pack to inspect (e.g. 'filesystem').

tools.name: bouncer_audit_summary
tools.description: Retrieve recent audit log entries from Bouncer showing allowed, denied, and asked tool calls with their timestamps and reasons.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent entries to return (default: 20).

prompts.name: review_mcp_security
prompts.description: Evaluate an MCP server's security contracts, identifying potential data exfiltration channels, high-risk sinks, and missing path constraints.

prompts.name: generate_bouncer_policy
prompts.description: Draft a declarative, deterministic YAML policy for Bouncer protecting against prompt injection and unauthorized destination exfiltration.

resources.name: Bouncer Builtin Policies
resources.description: Active curated security packs and deterministic contract schemas.

resources.name: Bouncer Audit Log Summary
resources.description: Recent audit trail of deterministic verdicts (ALLOW/DENY/ASK).
